# Graph operations · paper

Ports, defaults, and constraints come from the registered operations. Use `graph describe <op> --json` for the full structured record.

### paper.relief



Origin: toolkit.
Samples the graph clock.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `field` | Required | {"layout":"Function or native object with a sample method"} |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} · {"levels":{"type":"array<number>","constraints":{"increasing":true,"minItems":1,"maxItems":64},"default":[0.1,0.3,0.5]},"cell":{"type":"number","unit":"world units","constraints":{"exclusiveMin":0},"default":0.06}} |
| Output | `value` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |

Guides: [guide](../paper-relief.md#fields-queries-and-tooling)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe paper.relief --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.
